title: Date Night Disco (70s Couples Night)
description: A 70s-themed couples date night hosted by DJ Ron Allen — disco, cocktails, and an excuse to dress up together. Built for pairs who want a high-energy night out without the awkward bar scene. Pull out the wide collars and platforms.

title: illumine 2026 — Oakland Cemetery After Dark
description: Immersive light art installations by local Atlanta artists transform the historic cemetery at night, with bars, live entertainment, and the city skyline as backdrop. Unforgettable, slightly haunting, and a perfect excuse to hold hands. Proceeds support the Historic Oakland Foundation.

title: Rooftop Salsa & Bachata Social
location: Downtown Atlanta rooftop (see golatindance.com for venue)
description: Sunday afternoon rooftop salsa and bachata social — beginner-friendly with on-site lessons before open floor. Great for couples who want to learn something together or just enjoy tropical vibes and skyline views.

title: SABOR — Latin Summer Social at Block & Drum
description: Baila Atlanta's monthly first-Thursday salsa and bachata social — vinyl-spun salsa, bachata, and the kind of low-pressure crowd that actually welcomes new dancers. Free entry means an easy first date, no commitment required.

title: La Mezcla Dance Social
description: Late-night dance social mixing genres — perfect for couples who burn the midnight oil. High energy, good music, and a friendly mixed crowd that doesn't take itself too seriously.

title: Couples Therapy: A Relationship-Themed Comedy Show
description: A stand-up show literally built around love, dating, and relationships — 18+ adult content. Low-stakes laughs for a couple that can laugh at itself. Pair it with a pre-show dinner in the area.

title: Date Night Tuesdays — Uptown Comedy Corner Open Mic
description: Tuesday date-night open mic — fresh material, surprise guests, and a casual atmosphere designed for couples. Cheaper than a big show, more intimate, and the open-mic format means you're seeing jokes that haven't been recycled yet.

title: Joe DeVito — Helium Comedy Club (In The Other Room)
description: Sharp, observational headliner Joe DeVito in Helium's intimate 'Other Room' — small capacity, big laughs. The kind of show where you walk out quoting lines to each other for the rest of the week.

title: Wynonna Judd & Melissa Etheridge — Raised On Radio Tour
location: Synovus Bank Amphitheater at Chastain Park, Atlanta
description: Two legendary voices, one summer night under the stars at Chastain Park. Bring a picnic, a bottle of wine, and your favorite person. Classic date-night move — outdoor amphitheater shows are hard to beat.

title: Sensual Friday — Live Music & Poetry After Dark
description: Late-night live music and spoken word at Apache XLR — sensual, intimate, and unmistakably adult. Great date energy for couples who like their night out with a little heat and a lot of soul.

title: The Fade — Kathryn Kampovsky at Johnson Lowe Gallery
description: A solo show of new paintings by Kathryn Kampovsky — moody, contemplative work. Opens July 24 and runs through mid-September, so you can revisit on slower days. A quiet, thoughtful stop on a Westside art walk.

title: Soft Machines Group Exhibition
location: The Artifice at Atlanta Utility Works
description: Group show exploring the line between organic and engineered — sculpture, mixed media, and the kind of work that sparks conversation. A great excuse to wander a gallery district and talk about what you see.

title: Mindful Seeing — ARTS ATL Exhibition Series
description: Four interconnected exhibitions by Carlyle Wolfe Lee, Tim Hunter, Amanda Joy Brown, and Scotty Peek. Free, low-key, and a perfect Saturday-afternoon stop before dinner.

title: Vegan Food, Wellness Market & Pump, Praise & Pilates
location: Life Space Hope and Wellness, Atlanta
description: Vegan food vendors, wellness market, and free pilates/praise-fit classes all day. Couples who like being active together will appreciate the workout options between bites — and you'll leave full and slightly more virtuous.

title: Foreign Fridays — Hip-Hop, Afrobeats, Reggae & R&B
description: Weekly Friday party spinning hip-hop, Afrobeats, reggae, and R&B — exactly the brief. Dancing-friendly crowd, food available, and an easy 'grab dinner, stay for the music' date flow.

title: Atlanta Food Lovers Festival at Piedmont Park
description: Day-long food festival in Piedmont Park with curated vendors, live music, and shaded lawn space. Easy, walkable, and built for grazing your way through the afternoon together. Vegetarian options are easy to find.

title: Moonlit Falls — Painting with a Twist (Date-Night Class)
description: Guided painting class on a 16x20 canvas — no experience needed, drinks encouraged. The 'slightly different than dinner' date that gives you a shared keepsake to take home.

title: J. Anthony Brown & Friends — City Winery Atlanta
location: City Winery Atlanta, 650 North Ave NE
description: Veteran comedian, actor, and radio personality J. Anthony Brown brings a headline set to City Winery — dinner-and-a-show built right in, with wine flowing and tableside seating. Date-night logistics already solved.

title: Soulful Sunday R&B Brunch — Kayte Burgess at Perfect Note
location: Perfect Note Atlanta, 3000 Windy Hill Rd, Marietta
description: Sunday R&B brunch with live vocals — the kind of lazy, soulful afternoon that turns into dinner. Make a day of it: food, music, and no need to dress up.

title: Jazz Brunch at C. Ellet's (The Battery Atlanta)
description: Live jazz, brunch classics, and the energy of The Battery — great for couples who want a polished-but-relaxed Sunday. Walk it off afterward around the shops and Truist Park area.
